body.statement: Can the order-optimal interval be replaced by a total feasible interval whose conditional expected length attains the exact asymptotic minimax constant simultaneously at every intersection of the four phases, while estimating the full donor covariance and the calendar long-run variance? The handle is the product-experiment ordered-modulus construction in \texttt{def:sharp-constant-handle}, with least-favorable tests calibrated after the moving-center Gram perturbation is controlled.
body.justification: Rate optimality does not identify the joint least-favorable law when two or more nonregular channels bind at once.
body.gap: Donoho (1994) and Armstrong and Kolesar (2018) solve Gaussian convex-class modulus problems with fixed operators; the product experiment here has random geometry, a Holder donor location, and estimated dependence.
body.consumer: An exact constant would support principled allocation of sampling resources when donor, calendar, and replication costs place an application near a phase boundary.
